newsitem.title: USA: Amarillo Biosciences hepatitis study to begin.
newsitem.headline: Amarillo Biosciences hepatitis study to begin.

text.p: Amarillo Biosciences Inc said Monday that McGill University in Montreal will begin a clinical study this month to test low dose oral interferon alpha as a combination treatment with high dose injectable interferon alpha in hepatitis C patients in Canada and Mexico.
Amarillo licenses the combination therapy from McGill, the patent holder on therapy.

According to the company, preliminary data from patients in Canada and Japan indicate that pretreatment with low dose oral interferon alpha preconditions patients to respond better to injectable interferon alpha.
The company said that the use of low dose oral interferon alpha may double the percentage of hepatitis C patients cured with injectable interferon.
The study is expected to eventually enroll 180 patients and could take 2-3 years to complete.
